name: Blind taste
summary: A real-life blind taste test: numbered boxes with their lids closed and steam curling out; everyone taps the boxes best to worst and medals stick to the lids, and when the whole chat is in the lids flip open together to show what was in each box, where it placed and how many points it got.
useWhen: settle it: who has the best pizza in town
rank them without knowing which is which
which coffee is actually best, no bias
is the frozen one secretly better lol
dontUseWhen: voting on places nobody has tried yet (use dinner-veto or claw-pick)
friends who aren't in the same room
ranking things you can see the names of (use tier-list)

sub.description: The question being settled, quoted from the chat

items.description: 3 to 5 things in the boxes; the box numbers are shuffled so they stay blind

kind.description: The food drawn inside the box

note.description: A line shown after the reveal, e.g. 'Arun's, heated in the rice cooker'

order.description: Every item index once, best first

said.description: What they said while tasting, in their words
